text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said Friday it plans to withdraw its registration for a public offering of stock.
The company it was withdrawing the registration because of conditions in the small-capitalization sector of the public equity markets.

"We are currently reviewing various financing proposals and we believe that such financing is available on favorable terms to the company," said Ora Smith, president and chief executive of Illinois Superconductor.
"We are confident that we will continue to have access to sufficient resources to support the ongoing execution of our current business plan."
The company filed its registration for the offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commisson on March 25.
